description: Données géographiques du réseau STAR : sites propres is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Un site propre désigne l'aménagement d'une voie ou d'un espace réservé à un transport en commun, Le site propre, s'il exclue les autres modes de déplacement motorisés, peut être ouvert aux taxis et aux vélos. SITE PROPRE INTÉGRAL La voie est complètement inaccessible par un autre mode de déplacement que le transport collectif. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are système de transport, véhicule de transport en commun, transport de voyageurs, métro, autobus. The portal shows 205 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
